name: pilot-deployment-gate-decision-evidence
purpose: Record deterministic evidence for every deployment-adapter gate decision so Pilot can prove when provider invocation was skipped, blocked, or allowed.

rules.skip: SKIP must record provider_invoked=false and must not be represented as deployment success.
rules.block: BLOCK must record provider_invoked=false and preserve the reason needed for remediation.
rules.allow: ALLOW records authorization to invoke the configured adapter but is not itself proof of deployment.
rules.audit: Every decision is machine-readable and attributable to the release candidate.
rules.production: No gate decision alone may produce PRODUCTION_VERIFIED.
